note: Libya's information authority and Commercial Registry on 2026-08-27 discussed the possibility of linking systems; no platform, pilot or procurement is stated (capture truncated).

facts.fact: A proof-of-concept Government Service Bus called Nawa, built in about a month at a national hackathon, linked four institutions (Tax Authority, Commercial Registry, Central Bank of Libya, Customs Authority) through 23 web service endpoints, and won the competition's grand prize in January 2025, per the paper's authors.

systems.owner: General Information Authority with the Libyan Digital Innovation Lab, Expertise France and the EU E-NABLE project

facts.fact: On 8 July 2026 the General Information Authority said its national projects, the Libyan National Data Exchange (LY-NDEX) among them, are a pillar enabling information exchange between government bodies; the story gives no go-live date, connected bodies or figures.

The General Information Authority, reporting a 20 April 2026 meeting with the Union of Chambers, describes the National Data Distributor as a sovereign operational platform for interoperability enabling secure exchange of data between entities, and says the Chambers Union's new electronic system is to interoperate with it; it names no connected bodies and gives no counts.

systems.system: Electronic system of the Union of Chambers

note: LY-NDEX is only named as reviewed as an enabler; its status, build or service is not stated.

facts.fact: LANA reports the commercial registry's executive programme includes a phase of electronic linking with banks and relevant public bodies to exchange data and check companies' legal status instantly, presented as a stage still to be completed.
facts.system: Commercial registry electronic linking with banks and public bodies

facts.fact: The chairman of the General Authority for Communications and Informatics said on 1 June 2026 that the National Data Distributor is linked to the banking sector, government agencies and service sectors.
The same chairman said the National Data Distributor recorded over 300 million data transactions last year.

systems.owner: General Authority for Communications and Informatics

facts.fact: Libya's General Information Authority says a cooperation agreement with the National Center for Health System Development provides for activating the electronic link between the Ministry's systems and the Authority's national database through the national data exchange network.

facts.fact: Libya's labour minister said Libya and Egypt agreed to activate an electronic link between their labour ministries, with a database of Egyptian workers in Libya, and joint technical committees to start the next week by relaunching the link system.
